rows.grounds: describes the tree's overall form; tu is indeclinable particle
ablative of compound mūla-agra indicating extent from root to tip

items.question: What physical form must a suitable ritual tree possess from root to tip?
premises: round-shaped form extends root to tip
items.inference: A suitable tree is round-shaped, many-branched, and firm-elongated from root to tip.
uncertainties: internal sandhi of vṛttākārastu is not expanded into separate rows
items.plain_english: It is round-shaped, from root to tip many-branched and firm-elongated.
